import pytest
from subject import extract_topics, topic_error

# Tests for extract_topics

def test_extract_topics_py_valid():
    source = '''TOPIC_FOO = "onex.event.producer.v1"
SUFFIX_BAR = 'onex.command.producer.v2'
'''
    result = extract_topics("file.py", source)
    assert result == [(1, "onex.event.producer.v1"), (2, "onex.command.producer.v2")]

def test_extract_topics_ts_valid():
    source = '''export const TOPIC_FOO = "onex.event.producer.v1";
export const SUFFIX_BAR = 'onex.command.producer.v2';
'''
    result = extract_topics("file.ts", source)
    assert result == [(1, "onex.event.producer.v1"), (2, "onex.command.producer.v2")]

def test_extract_topics_other_extension():
    source = 'TOPIC_FOO = "onex.event.producer.v1"'
    result = extract_topics("file.txt", source)
    assert result == []

def test_extract_topics_no_matches():
    source = "no topics here"
    result = extract_topics("file.py", source)
    assert result == []

def test_extract_topics_multiple_matches_same_line():
    source = 'TOPIC_A = "onex.a.v1"; TOPIC_B = "onex.b.v2"'
    result = extract_topics("file.py", source)
    assert result == [(1, "onex.a.v1"), (1, "onex.b.v2")]

def test_extract_topics_line_numbers():
    source = '''

TOPIC_FOO = "onex.event.producer.v1"
'''
    result = extract_topics("file.py", source)
    assert result == [(3, "onex.event.producer.v1")]

def test_extract_topics_case_insensitive_extension():
    source = 'TOPIC_FOO = "onex.event.producer.v1"'
    result = extract_topics("FILE.PY", source)
    assert result == [(1, "onex.event.producer.v1")]
